title: Close the GENERAL_NAME union representation mechanism (single-writer constructor family + selector-guarded readers)

source_identity.note: The subagent does not commit; the gate ran against the uncommitted working tree on top of febdf3f3d.

authority_contract: crypto/x509/v3_genn.c GENERAL_NAME set0/get0/cmp/free/dup plus the ASN1_CHOICE item layout; include/openssl/x509v3.h:172-193; ABI: struct GENERAL_NAME_st is int type followed by a union of pointer arms, all arms alias the same 8-byte slot.

inventory.excluded_other_unions: PKCS7/CMS/SIV d fields share the name but are different structs

ownership_before: Every module wrote and read GeneralName::d directly. Construction order varied (arm then selector, selector then arm, in-place X509_NAME_set through &mut d.directoryName, addr_of_mut! on d.directoryName). Two reads (cmp_vfy cert_acceptable, check_msg_find_cert) and five v3_san accessor helpers read the arm without checking the selector, relying on an undocumented caller obligation.
ownership_after: One audited writer, GeneralName::install (safe, pub(crate)), clears the slot and writes the selector and arm together. Typed setters (set_other_name, set_ia5, set_x400, set_directory_name, set_edi_party_name, set_ip_address, set_registered_id) are the only outside entry points and reject a selector that does not name their arm. GENERAL_NAME_set0_value dispatches to those setters; unhandled selectors still normalise to a cleared slot. One selector-checked reader, GeneralName::as_ref, backs the typed accessors (other_name, ia5, x400, directory_name, edi_party_name, ip_address, registered_id) and arm_ptr. Every accessor answers None/NULL on a selector mismatch; no reference is formed for an unnamed arm.

mechanisms.name: GENERAL_NAME selected-arm representation
eliminated: 2 unguarded arm reads in cmp_vfy.rs (now selector-guarded accessor calls)
5 v3_san accessor helpers whose only guarantee was an undocumented caller contract (now self-guarding)
3 read/write sites that formed a Rust place over d.<arm> via deref or &mut (now 0)
relocated: the union write coordination into GeneralName::install (one switch, one slot write plus selector)
the union read coordination into GeneralName::as_ref and the typed accessors (one switch, discriminant checked before any reference)
the build-then-publish sequence in a2i_GENERAL_NAME into a local arm followed by one install call

removed: 19 direct union-arm writes/reads outside v3_genn.rs were replaced by safe method calls on the audited family (the unsafe pointer work around them remains, and is unchanged)
retained: 20 raw-pointer-only arm reads outside v3_genn.rs: cmp_hdr 1, cmp_server 1, cmp_vfy 1, crmf 1, ess 1, ocsp_vfy 1, ts_rsp_verify 1, v3_ncons 1, v3_purp 2, v3_utl 6, x509_acert 1, x509_vfy 2, x_crl 1. Each is preceded by an explicit type_==GEN_* / match type_ check and a SAFETY comment stating the discriminant and pointee contract.
GeneralName::as_ref / arm_ptr and the 7 typed accessors: the single unsafe read boundary (each has a # Safety section).
GeneralName::install and the typed setters are safe; they perform no read and no release.
introduced: 7 new unsafe blocks inside the typed accessors (non-test unsafe blocks 41 -> 48); each is a single `unsafe { self.as_ref() }` call with a SAFETY comment and no new proof obligation beyond as_ref's existing contract
no new extern symbol, no changed exported signature, no new #[no_mangle] function (28 before, 28 after); unsafe fn count 6 -> 13 (the 7 accessors, each with # Safety)

boundary: GeneralName::install (writer) and GeneralName::as_ref (reader) are the two halves of the representation boundary. They exist because the C ABI fixes the layout as an untagged union selected by an int; the selector is the only discriminator.

discharged: In-crate construction: every arm write now establishes the matching selector in the same call (install).
Decoder provenance: d2i_GENERAL_NAME already refuses an out-of-range selector and a NULL selected arm.
Read side: every reference-forming accessor proves the discriminant before forming a reference and returns None on mismatch.
Destructor: ASN1_item_free's CHOICE arm reads the selector and releases only the selected in-range alternative; out-of-range and NULL arms release nothing (verified in src/asn1/fre.rs and by tests).
Comparison: GENERAL_NAME_cmp returns -1 for a selector mismatch, an unhandled selector, or a NULL arm before any arm-specific comparison; X.400 compares only through ASN1_STRING_cmp.
retained: ABI precondition (external): a C caller of GENERAL_NAME_set0_value must pass a live value of the arm that type_ names. A wrong-type pairing cannot be detected at read time because every arm aliases the same 8-byte slot; it remains the caller's UB, stated in the function's # Safety.
GENERAL_NAME_set0_value does not release the previous arm (authority behaviour). Callers that replace an arm own the old one.
The 20 retained raw reads rely on the enclosing selector check; the pointee-validity part is owned by the value's builder/decoder/ABI contract.
a2i_GENERAL_NAME and i2d/dup still require the ABI pairing precondition to hold for a value received from C.
introduced: None beyond the typed accessors' documented `self`-liveness and pointee-validity precondition, which is the same obligation as_ref already carried.

compatibility_delta.change: set0_value for an unhandled selector clears the union and records the selector; the authority leaves the previous bytes in d (CVE-2023-0286 residue). This behaviour predates S16 and is retained.
compatibility_delta.observed: an_unknown_selector_is_unreadable_and_safe_to_free: selector 99 leaves d.ia5 NULL and the un-adopted IA5 string is untouched.

compatibility_delta.class: UB in the C authority not reproduced (AGENTS.md 17)
compatibility_delta.change: crmf OSSL_CRMF_CERTID_gen and ocsp OCSP_request_set1_name now duplicate the name first and install it on success, instead of X509_NAME_set on the raw union slot. On allocation failure the previous arm is untouched; the authority's unconditional wrong-type free cannot occur. These items are freshly allocated, so the success path is identical.
compatibility_delta.observed: cargo check + clippy clean; focused tests pass.

compatibility_delta.change: a2i_GENERAL_NAME builds the arm in a local and installs it only after it is fully valid. A failed build no longer stages a partial arm in a caller-supplied out GENERAL_NAME; the partial arm is released here. Successful builds are unchanged.
compatibility_delta.observed: focused genn tests pass; no existing v3_san test asserted the old failure residue.
